mapping: signal close S; next session T through T+4
scaled_target: log(raw future quote / S close) / max(S volatility_20, 0.0001)
weighting: equal dates within each window; equal windows
primary_metric: T+4 close mean q10/q50/q90 pinball in unscaled log price units
threshold_status: provisional engineering screening targets; fixed before this run, informed by prior experiments
inference: three development windows cannot establish statistical significance or future performance
prior_exposure: historical quarters may have been used in ranking work; fold14 used in price pilots
sealed_holdout_policy: never read evaluation labels in or after sealed_holdout_start
promotion: passing permits a decision-value experiment only; never daily recommendation or live readiness
decision_phase: blocked until price gate passes; separately preregister dynamic-rule versus fixed-rule comparison
report_phase: after decision-value and prospective verification; not a success criterion here
